LightningComponentBundle.description: Shows who else is viewing the record, and alerts users when someone else saves it so they can refresh instead of working on an outdated version.

property.name: heartbeatSeconds
property.label: Heartbeat Interval (seconds)
property.description: How often each open record tab checks in, from 15 to 120 seconds. Alerts arrive within about one interval of a change. Each check is one Apex call.

property.name: showViewers
property.label: Show Viewers
property.description: Show the avatars of other users viewing the record. Turn off to use only the record updated alerts.

property.name: maxAvatars
property.label: Maximum Avatars
property.description: Avatars shown before the rest collapse into +N.

property.name: alertStyle
property.label: Alert Style
property.description: How users are told someone else changed the record: a modal asking them to refresh, or only the banner in the component's place.

property.name: autoRefreshSeconds
property.label: Auto-Refresh Countdown (seconds)
property.description: 0 = off. Above 0, the modal refreshes the record by itself after this many seconds unless the user clicks or presses a key in it. Warning: the record reloads even while the user is editing it. The standard record detail and Edit modal keep unsaved edits, but other components on the page can lose unsaved input.
